findings.highlight: I realize this is the last time.
findings.evidenceJa: これが最後なのだと感じていた
findings.governingReading: He feels that this is the last time.
findings.explanation: A subjective premonition is promoted into realization of fact.

findings.highlight: Every time she won a battle, Arturia was made to wish for a battle she did not wish for.
findings.evidenceJa: 戦に勝利する度に、望まぬ戦いを望まれたアルトリア
findings.governingReading: With each victory, others demanded another war that Arturia herself did not want.
findings.explanation: The people demanding war are erased and Arturia is made the experiencer of a contradictory forced wish.

findings.highlight: I am not sure how far she went
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の妄念が、どのような手を尽くしたのか定かではない
findings.governingReading: It is unknown what measures Morgan’s obsession drove her to take.
findings.explanation: Uncertainty about the concrete means Morgan used becomes a vague judgment about how far she went.

findings.highlight: a knight with an unknown father
findings.evidenceJa: 父を明かせぬ騎士
findings.governingReading: a knight unable to reveal his father
findings.explanation: A deliberately concealed paternal identity becomes one that is simply unknown.

findings.highlight: The end final battle of King Arthur.
findings.evidenceJa: アーサー王最後の戦い
findings.governingReading: King Arthur’s final battle
findings.explanation: Three competing noun choices remain visible and leave the historical caption grammatically broken.

findings.highlight: a fatal wound
findings.evidenceJa: もはや癒せない傷
findings.governingReading: a wound that could no longer be healed
findings.explanation: The source defines incurability; the English asserts fatality and collapses the distinction between the wound’s nature and the later death.

findings.highlight: The last of her, the one called the king of knights.
findings.evidenceJa: 騎士王と言われた彼女の、最後の姿だった
findings.governingReading: It was the final figure of the woman called the King of Knights.
findings.explanation: The English leaves a fragment whose phrase “the last of her” does not express her last appearance.

findings.highlight: Every one of her twelve battles was severe
findings.evidenceJa: 十二もの戦いはそのどれもが身を削くような戦い
findings.governingReading: Each of the twelve battles wore or carved away her very body.
findings.explanation: The cumulative bodily cost of Arturia’s campaigns is reduced to generic severity.

findings.highlight: this just happened to be the greatest wound
findings.evidenceJa: もっとも大きな傷跡に他ならない
findings.governingReading: This is nothing other than the greatest scar, fitting for the final battle.
findings.explanation: Just happened adds accident or coincidence to the culminating scar.

findings.highlight: returned to Britain her territory
findings.evidenceJa: 領地に戻り
findings.governingReading: returned to her territory
findings.explanation: An abandoned specific place name and its replacement are both printed.

findings.highlight: her own son, even if he was son only in name
findings.evidenceJa: カタチの上であれ、息子であった騎士
findings.governingReading: the knight who was, in formal shape or relation, her son
findings.explanation: “Only in name” dismisses the kinship more strongly than the source’s qualification of its form.

findings.highlight: The lone king, who tried to be a king until her last moments
findings.evidenceJa: 最後まで王として在り続けようとした、一人の騎士
findings.governingReading: A single knight who tried to remain a king until the end
findings.explanation: The sentence’s simultaneous identification of Arturia as one knight and as king is collapsed entirely into kingship.

findings.highlight: But I have to wish.
findings.evidenceJa: ただ、願ってしまった
findings.governingReading: He finds himself wishing.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s involuntary emotional wish becomes a duty or necessity to wish.

findings.highlight: If my wound has healed, I’m fine. But Saber’s different. Even though she can heal her wounds, her magical energy isn’t infinite. It wouldn’t be a problem if she had just fought, but she used Excalibur. She used Excalibur. She may not even have enough magical energy to heal herself.
findings.evidenceJa: 今はエクスカリバーを使った後だ。自然治癒の為の魔力も不足しているのではないだろうか
findings.governingReading: Having just used Excalibur, Saber may lack even the magical energy needed for natural recovery.
findings.explanation: mirror moon inserts several unsupported explanatory sentences, repeats Excalibur, and invents a contrast with ordinary fighting before returning to the source proposition.

findings.highlight: I cannot treat wounds as Rin does.
findings.evidenceJa: 人の傷を診る事はできません
findings.governingReading: She cannot examine or diagnose another person’s wounds as Rin can.
findings.explanation: Saber’s limitation in assessing injuries becomes inability to treat them.

findings.highlight: She hesitates, squeezing the towel.
findings.evidenceJa: え……まぁ、それは、そうなのですが……
findings.governingReading: Saber verbally hesitates; the source gives no accompanying towel action.
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds a physical action absent from the running Japanese.

findings.highlight: I can’t sleep with a peace of mind
findings.evidenceJa: 落ち着いて眠れない
findings.governingReading: I cannot sleep at ease
findings.explanation: The count-noun construction produces malformed English.

findings.highlight: I let Saber take care of me
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの看病を見守った
findings.governingReading: He watches Saber nurse him.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s attentive observation becomes permission for Saber to provide care.

findings.highlight: the weak moonlight
findings.evidenceJa: 消え入りそうな月明かりの陰影
findings.governingReading: the shading of moonlight that itself seems about to fade away
findings.explanation: The source locates the ephemerality in the fading play of light and shadow; the English reduces it to low brightness.

findings.highlight: if I’m happy or lonely
findings.evidenceJa: 安堵したのか、寂しいのか
findings.governingReading: whether he is relieved or lonely
findings.explanation: Relief after Saber retires is changed into happiness and alters the emotional contrast.

findings.highlight: I have to tell her that I’m not wrong about this.
findings.evidenceJa: その事だけは、間違っていないと伝えないと
findings.governingReading: He must tell her that this one proposition is not mistaken.
findings.explanation: A conviction about the claim—that Saber should smile for herself—becomes a defense of Shirou’s personal correctness.

findings.highlight: say this
findings.evidenceJa: 噛むように口にした
findings.governingReading: He bites the words out.
findings.explanation: The strained, almost painful manner of Shirou forcing out the irreversible demand disappears.

findings.highlight: you have to find your own happiness
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーが幸せにならないなんて嘘だ
findings.governingReading: It cannot be right that Saber receives no happiness.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s protest that an unhappy outcome is intolerably false becomes an assignment for Saber to find happiness herself.

findings.highlight: you can go back to being Arturia
findings.evidenceJa: アルトリアに戻っていいんだ、と続きます。発声しませんが一応。
findings.governingReading: The direction says the thought continues this way but is not voiced.
findings.explanation: mirror moon completes Shirou’s cut-off spoken line with words explicitly marked unspoken in the source.

findings.highlight: you continued to invade me
findings.evidenceJa: 私の中に何度も入ってきた
findings.governingReading: You entered into my inner memories again and again.
findings.explanation: The shared-dream relation becomes an ongoing hostile physical invasion, distorting Saber’s account of why Shirou knows her answer.

findings.highlight: I want to be with you, Saber.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺はもっと、ずっとセイバーと一緒にいたい
findings.governingReading: He wants to be with Saber more, and for a long time to come.
findings.explanation: Both greater closeness and continued duration disappear from the confession.

findings.highlight: Her gorgeous neck
findings.evidenceJa: 華奢な首筋
findings.governingReading: her delicate, slender neck
findings.explanation: Physical fragility is replaced by an evaluative compliment.

findings.highlight: I wanted to become a superhero.
findings.evidenceJa: “正義の味方”なんてものを目指しておきながら
findings.governingReading: Even while aspiring to become an ally of justice
findings.explanation: Shirou’s inherited ethical ideal is replaced with the genre label superhero.

findings.highlight: I never fell in love with anyone, nor was I ever unwilling to let go of anyone.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺は何かを愛しいと。誰かを離したくないと、思う事さえなかったのか
findings.governingReading: Had he never before even thought something precious, or wished not to let someone go?
findings.explanation: A shocked rhetorical discovery about emotional capacity becomes a settled factual biography, while 愛しい is narrowed to romantic love.

findings.highlight: my lips feel Saber’s kindness
findings.evidenceJa: 唇だけは鋭敏なほど、セイバーの優しさを感じていた
findings.governingReading: His lips alone, with almost painful sensitivity, feel Saber’s gentleness.
findings.explanation: The exceptional sensory concentration in the kiss disappears.

findings.highlight: Saber’s hand on my chest pushes us apart a bit.
findings.evidenceJa: 胸に置かれたセイバーの手が、少し、距離を作る
findings.governingReading: The hand on his chest creates a little distance.
findings.explanation: The English adds a more active rejection force than the carefully neutral source verb.

findings.highlight: contradict me
findings.evidenceJa: 否定してくれていい
findings.governingReading: You may deny or reject what I am claiming about us.
findings.explanation: A decisive relational rejection becomes mere disagreement in argument.

findings.highlight: her softness
findings.evidenceJa: その身体のたおやかさ
findings.governingReading: the graceful suppleness of her body
findings.explanation: A specific quality of flexible, delicate grace becomes generic softness.

findings.highlight: How many times did our hearts beat?
findings.evidenceJa: どれほどの鼓動と吐息の数が刻まれたのか
findings.governingReading: How many heartbeats and breaths were marked in that silence?
findings.explanation: The breaths jointly measuring the long silence are omitted.

findings.highlight: I cannot answer your feeling.
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方の気持ちには応えられない
findings.governingReading: I cannot reciprocate your feelings.
findings.explanation: The literal collocation is unnatural and obscures Saber’s refusal of romantic reciprocity.

findings.highlight: She wants to stay like this until the night ends.
findings.evidenceJa: 叶わない望みを告げている
findings.governingReading: Her body and eyes communicate an unattainable wish to remain this way until dawn.
findings.explanation: The narration’s insistence that the wish cannot be fulfilled disappears.

findings.highlight: Her quiet voice stops me.
findings.evidenceJa: 密やかな声が、許すように、押し止めた
findings.governingReading: Her hushed voice stops him as though granting permission.
findings.explanation: The delicate function of Saber’s explanation as the only permission she can offer is omitted.

findings.highlight: her biggest modest wish
findings.evidenceJa: 精一杯の、ささやかな願い
findings.governingReading: the utmost small, quiet wish she can permit herself
findings.explanation: The English forms a contradictory phrase and loses the sense that this small wish exhausts what Saber can allow.

findings.highlight: This is the distance between us
findings.evidenceJa: 触れあうだけの距離だった
findings.governingReading: It was a distance at which they could do no more than touch.
findings.explanation: The boundary limiting intimacy to physical closeness alone disappears.

findings.highlight: Please allow me to sleep here tonight.
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方と眠らせてください
findings.governingReading: Please allow me to sleep with you tonight.
findings.explanation: Saber’s explicit request for shared sleep is weakened into permission to sleep in a location.

findings.highlight: the depressing thought
findings.evidenceJa: 胸の中に浮かんだ邪念
findings.governingReading: the impure thought that arose within him
findings.explanation: Sexual or impure anticipation is mistranslated as sadness or depression.

findings.highlight: I quietly swallow my breath.
findings.evidenceJa: 静かに息を呑む
findings.governingReading: He quietly catches his breath.
findings.explanation: A literal calque produces an unnatural bodily action.

findings.highlight: She murmurs such a thing.
findings.evidenceJa: そんな、胸が痛くなるようなコトを、囁いてきた
findings.governingReading: She whispers the request that makes his heart ache.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s painful emotional reaction to Saber asking for his arm as a pillow disappears.

findings.highlight: To hear her reply to my question.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が彼女が欲しいと求めた、その答えを聞く為に
findings.governingReading: He wants her answer to his expressed desire for her.
findings.explanation: The relationship question and Shirou’s desire are reduced to an unspecified prior question.

findings.highlight: Is that not right? Because you have…
findings.evidenceJa: ……そうでしょう、シロウ
findings.governingReading: Surely that is so, Shirou.
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds an unfinished causal clause to Saber’s speech, then strands its continuation as a fragment on the next page.

findings.highlight: Let us return to our previous selves
findings.evidenceJa: またいつもの私たちに戻りましょう
findings.governingReading: Let us return to the way we usually are.
findings.explanation: Saber’s restoration of their habitual relationship after this one night becomes a return to former identities or selves.

findings.highlight: My last vision of Saber sees her smiling warmly.
findings.evidenceJa: 最後に映ったセイバーは、温かく微笑んでいた
findings.governingReading: The last image reflected in his eyes is Saber smiling warmly.
findings.explanation: The English makes an abstract vision the agent that sees and leaves the focal image grammatically malformed.

findings.highlight: I fall into a comfortable sleep.
findings.evidenceJa: 満ち足りた眠りに落ちる
findings.governingReading: He falls into satisfied, fulfilled sleep.
findings.explanation: Emotional fulfillment from the held hand becomes physical comfort.

findings.highlight: Without knowing if we would be able to keep our hands connected even after everything is over.
findings.evidenceJa: この手を繋いでいられるかどうかも分からないまま、静かに
findings.governingReading: Quietly, still not knowing whether they can remain hand in hand after everything ends.
findings.explanation: The final adverb’s hushed suspension is omitted from the scene’s closing cadence.
